title: Per-component breakdown of a generalized cost: component key -> weighted contribution, in the same unit as `cost`; the contributions sum to `cost`. Omitted components contribute 0.

travel_time.title: Weighted contribution of travel_time (vehicle travel time, including accepted late arrivals and the priced depot return); omitted = 0

distance.title: Weighted contribution of distance (vehicle travel distance; requires dist_filepath); omitted = 0

ride_time.title: Weighted contribution of ride_time (ride from the pickup departure to the drop-off arrival); omitted = 0

passenger_delay.title: Weighted contribution of passenger_delay (drop-off delay versus the ideal direct ride starting at the desired pickup time); omitted = 0

earliness.title: Weighted contribution of earliness (arrival before required_arrival_time); omitted = 0

plan_duration.title: Weighted contribution of plan_duration (plan departure to the end of the last action or the depot return; 0 for empty plans); omitted = 0

fixed_plan.title: Weighted contribution of fixed_plan (constant per non-empty plan); omitted = 0

vehicle_capital.title: Weighted contribution of vehicle_capital (constant per non-empty plan (the legacy vehicle capital cost)); omitted = 0
